# everpure_azure_snapshot (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Volume Group Snapshot by name and its Volume Group. This includes snapshots taken by the volume group's snapshot schedule.

To create and manage a manual snapshot, use the [`everpure_azure_snapshot` resource](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure/latest/docs/resources/azure_snapshot).

Soft-deleted snapshots can't be looked up with this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    everpure = {
      source = "PureStorage-OpenConnect/everpure-azure"
    }
  }
}

provider "everpure" {
  subscription_id = var.subscription_id
}

variable "subscription_id" {
  type = string
}

data "everpure_azure_volume_group" "example" {
  name            = "vg-prod-east"
  storage_pool_id = "/subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/rg-storage-prod/providers/PureStorage.Block/storagePools/pool-prod-east"
}

# Looks up a snapshot created outside this Terraform configuration. A snapshot
# taken by the volume group's snapshot schedule is named with digits only.
data "everpure_azure_snapshot" "example" {
  name            = "snap-before-upgrade"
  volume_group_id = data.everpure_azure_volume_group.example.id
}

# A volume restored from that snapshot. volume_name is the name the source volume
# had when the snapshot was taken.
resource "everpure_azure_volume" "restored" {
  name            = "vol-prod-data-restored"
  volume_group_id = data.everpure_azure_volume_group.example.id
  source_type     = "snapshot"

  source_snapshot {
    id          = data.everpure_azure_snapshot.example.id
    volume_name = data.everpure_azure_snapshot.example.volume_snapshots[0].volume_name
  }
}

output "snapshot_id" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_snapshot.example.id
}

output "snapshot_created_at" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_snapshot.example.created_at
}

output "snapshot_created_by_policy" {
  value = data.everpure_azure_snapshot.example.created_by_policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot. A snapshot taken by the volume group's snapshot schedule has a name made of digits.
- `volume_group_id` (String) Full Azure Resource Manager ID of the volume group the snapshot belongs to. Must be in the provider's own `subscription_id`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the snapshot was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC. Timestamps sort chronologically as strings.
- `created_by_policy` (Boolean) Whether the snapshot was taken by the volume group's snapshot schedule, rather than manually.
- `id` (String) The full Azure Resource Manager ID of the snapshot.
- `space` (Attributes) Space usage, in bytes. Null when the service reports none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space))
- `volume_snapshots` (Attributes List) The snapshot of each volume in the volume group at the time the snapshot was taken. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_snapshots))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) Defaults to 5 minutes. A duration string: a number with a unit suffix s (seconds), m (minutes) or h (hours); segments can be combined, e.g. "30m" or "1h30m". Used when reading the snapshot.


<a id="nestedatt--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `space`

Read-Only:

- `shared_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by duplicated data, meaning data shared among different volumes and snapshots as a result of data deduplication, in bytes.
- `snapshots_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by data unique to one or more snapshots, in bytes.
- `total_used_in_bytes` (Number) Total space occupied by customer data, in bytes. This is the space being billed for.
- `unique_in_bytes` (Number) Unique space occupied by customer data, in bytes.


<a id="nestedatt--volume_snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume_snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `provisioned_size_in_bytes` (Number) Provisioned size of the source volume, in bytes.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number of the source volume, as recorded when the snapshot was taken.
- `space` (Attributes) Space usage, in bytes. Null when the service reports none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volume_snapshots--space))
- `volume_name` (String) Name of the source volume when the snapshot was taken. This is the value for `source_snapshot.volume_name` on an `everpure_azure_volume` restoring from this snapshot.

<a id="nestedatt--volume_snapshots--space"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volume_snapshots.space`

Read-Only:

- `shared_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by duplicated data, meaning data shared among different volumes and snapshots as a result of data deduplication, in bytes.
- `snapshots_in_bytes` (Number) Space occupied by data unique to one or more snapshots, in bytes.
- `total_used_in_bytes` (Number) Total space occupied by customer data, in bytes. This is the space being billed for.
- `unique_in_bytes` (Number) Unique space occupied by customer data, in bytes.
